intent: 仅依据当前仓库实现代码与分发配置，判断项目是否符合 CLI 生命周期分发及 Coding Agent Source 控制层诉求。

acceptanceCriteria.observable: 逐项核对 .agents、knowledge、rules、specs、workflows 和四个模板是否存在且进入分发。
从入口和调用链确认 init、upgrade、uninstall 以及恢复边界。
确认 CLI 是否自行发现最新版本并同步完整 Source。
确认远程 Skill 源是否被安装或更新，并由 Workflow 映射到不同 Stage。
确认 Stage、Required Skill、Policy、Gate、Revision 和持久化推进是否由实现强制。
确认 fresh init 后是否直接形成可被 Coding Agent 使用的有效治理入口。

risk.rollback: No source or lifecycle apply was performed; only task-scoped Evidence and Harness private control state were created.
interpretationBoundaries: If '调用技能' means declaring and requiring an Agent-produced receipt, the Runtime supports it; if it means executing a Skill, it does not.
If '同步最新' means applying the contents of an already-selected newest npm package, upgrade supports it; if it means discovering latest itself, it does not.

findings.claim: The npm package exposes one zero-dependency Distribution CLI with init, upgrade, doctor, uninstall, recover and version commands.
The requested Source paths exist and are projected by the Distribution Manifest; source/.agents contains only skills.sources.json and materialized Skill data is rejected by the distribution checker.

Lifecycle apply is ownership-aware and recoverable: plans stage files and backups, commits a canonical journal, supports resume/rollback, blocks active Runtime work, and preserves modified uninstall targets.
upgrade applies Source embedded in the currently executing package but has no latest-version discovery, remote fetch, or sync command.
Remote Skill sources are configuration-only. Production code never consumes skills.sources.json; the checker only validates and the lifecycle copies it.
Workflow supports per-Stage skill declarations and validates receipts, but the default catalog contains only the bundled ai-vibe-demo-kit guide and every default Stage requires that same Skill.

The Harness controls progression through required Conditions and Skill receipts, revision checks, policy blocks, human gates, pause/redirect/abort decisions and persisted control state; it validates claimed Skill completion but does not execute Skills.
Fresh init installs templates under source/ but does not materialize effective AGENTS.md, AI_ENVIRONMENT.md, project.yml or Coding Agent rules; Doctor therefore requires manual governance setup.
source/manifest.json is package-only and absent from initialized targets although both distributed templates name it as authoritative context.
The four governance templates are seed-owned. Upgrade refreshes untouched seeds but preserves modified seeds, so literal full-Source synchronization is intentionally incomplete.
The implementation is functionally three-layered: Distribution CLI, installed Harness Runtime, and Source data/templates. Source alone is not the progression controller.

decision: The project has a strong lifecycle and deterministic control kernel, but does not fully satisfy the stated product intent until latest-package discovery, remote Skill materialization/routing, fresh-init governance activation, and the missing installed source/manifest.json contract are resolved or explicitly declared out of scope.
